mechanism: Betamethasone may increase loperamide levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism and increasing the risk of antimotility agent complications in the setting of inflammatory bowel disease.
action: Monitor for loperamide toxicity (CNS effects, cardiac arrhythmias); use lowest effective loperamide dose and consider alternatives; avoid loperamide in acute inflammatory bowel disease with corticosteroid use due to toxic megacolon risk.
